data.rationale: Scenario-owned durable data observed in the canonical data directory.

budget.rationale: Durable storage is bounded by the workload byte ceiling; it is alarm-only because the data is not regenerable.

logs.rationale: Scenario operational logs observed in the canonical logs directory.

budget.rationale: Regenerable storage is retained for 30 days and reclaimed by age; the window is the workload retention requirement.

retention.rationale: Shared storage retention enforcement writes a small receipt under the scenario state retention directory.

budget.rationale: Retention receipts are bounded regenerable operational state.

storage.rationale: Storage surfaces are declared from observed canonical scenario directories; external resource databases are not claimed by this scenario.

service.name: secrets-manager
service.description: Dark chrome security dashboard for discovering, validating, and provisioning secrets required by Vrooli resources

descriptors.label: Mail-in-a-Box administrator password
descriptors.description: Migrated operator credential retained for the Mail-in-a-Box integration.

descriptors.label: n8n API key
descriptors.description: Migrated operator credential retained for n8n automation integrations.

descriptors.label: n8n password
descriptors.description: Migrated operator credential retained for n8n automation integrations.

descriptors.label: Legacy test API key
descriptors.description: Migrated operator credential retained for test and validation tooling.

descriptors.label: Secrets Manager vault encryption key
descriptors.description: Lifecycle-provided 32-byte key for encrypted password-manager payloads. Missing material requires recovery and never remints a key.

descriptors.label: Secrets Manager owner authentication token
descriptors.description: Explicit local fallback for development; production deployments should use the Scenario Authenticator JWKS relying-party boundary.

descriptors.label: Secrets Manager native-host transport token
descriptors.description: Installed native-host transport capability. The host remains unavailable until this token and an owner authentication session are configured.

descriptors.label: Secrets Manager deployment service token
descriptors.description: Scoped machine credential accepted only by tier-specific deployment manifest endpoints. It has no vault or owner authority.

setup.description: Install CLI, build API, initialize database, and produce a production UI bundle

data-backup-manager.runtime_only_rationale: Secrets Manager reaches Data Backup Manager through its discovered Connect boundary for coverage, drill, and restore evidence; recovery remains explicitly degraded when the provider is unavailable.
data-backup-manager.purpose: Production backup, restore, and recovery evidence for encrypted vault custody
data-backup-manager.degraded_behavior: Vault operations remain available, while recovery readiness reports unavailable or degraded until Data Backup Manager is ready.

scenario-authenticator.runtime_only_rationale: Secrets Manager resolves Scenario Authenticator by slug for browser sign-in and verifies its JWTs locally against the published JWKS.
scenario-authenticator.purpose: Human owner authentication for the same-origin password-manager UI
scenario-authenticator.degraded_behavior: The local owner-token and first-owner enrollment paths remain available when Scenario Authenticator is stopped; browser sign-in reports an explicit provider-unavailable error.
